description: This file represents the code-behind for the 'TheorySet.aspx' page in an online examination system. It handles course selection based on semester, adding questions to the database, setting exam details, navigation, and UI interactions.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the ASP.NET page handling theory questions, course selection, and exam setup.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, currently empty.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown list based on the selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new theory question into the 'theoryQS' database table, updates question number, and shows confirmation.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new exam record into 'theoryCourseDetail', then navigates to AdminPanel.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user by transferring to LoginPage.aspx.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question no textbox based on selected course.
